name: Solberg-Maru CoolDrift Vent Sandal
description: Open-footbed sandal in recycled rubber-composite sole with adjustable nylon-webbing straps in deep brown and terracotta, inspired loosely by East African and Andean strap traditions. Cooling gel insole layer reduces ground-heat transfer from baking urban pavement. Wide toe-box accommodates geneware foot modifications; strap system bypasses ankle chrome without pressure points.
functionality: Cooling gel insole for pavement heat, aug-compatible ankle strap routing, wide gene-mod toe box.
what_it_says: You know how hot Circuit pavement gets in August and you stopped pretending closed shoes are an option.
story_hooks: One strap was replaced with a different color — the original snapped during something the wearer won't discuss.
The gel insole still holds an impression of the previous owner's foot.
